posts.title: Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL on the Farm Sustainability Data Network (codification)
posts.label: 📋 New legislative proposal
posts.summary: This proposal aims to establish a network for collecting and sharing data about farming practices and sustainability on farms. It would help monitor how agricultural activities affect the environment and resource use across the region.
posts.whatsNext: Parliament's lead committee and the Council's working party examine it in parallel. No deadline applies at this stage; most files take one to two-plus years.

posts.title: Strengthening of the position of farmers in the food supply chain
posts.label: 📜 Published in the Official Journal
posts.summary: This legislation strengthens the bargaining power and position of farmers within the food supply chain. It aims to protect farmers' interests and ensure fairer treatment in their dealings with other businesses involved in food production and distribution.
posts.whatsNext: It's law. It enters into force on the date it specifies or, if none, the 20th day after publication in the Official Journal.

posts.title: Temporary derogation from certain provisions of the ePrivacy Directive to combat online child sexual abuse
posts.label: 📜 Published in the Official Journal
posts.summary: The law temporarily allows exceptions to privacy rules for electronic communications to help authorities detect and stop child sexual abuse online. It permits enhanced monitoring and analysis of communications to identify material involving child exploitation.
posts.whatsNext: It's law at EU level. Member states must now transpose it into national law by the deadline the act sets.

posts.title: Simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence – Digital Omnibus on AI (Omnibus VII)
posts.label: 📜 Published in the Official Journal
posts.summary: This law simplifies how artificial intelligence rules are applied across the EU by updating and streamlining various existing regulations. It makes it easier for businesses and authorities to comply with AI standards by removing unnecessary complexity from the implementation process.
posts.whatsNext: It's law. It enters into force on the date it specifies or, if none, the 20th day after publication in the Official Journal.

posts.title: Circularity requirements for vehicle design and management of end-of-life vehicles
posts.label: 📜 Published in the Official Journal
posts.summary: This law requires vehicles to be designed with circularity in mind, meaning they should use fewer raw materials and be easier to repair, reuse, and recycle. It also sets rules for how vehicles must be managed once they reach the end of their useful life to recover and reuse as many materials as possible.
posts.whatsNext: It's law. It enters into force on the date it specifies or, if none, the 20th day after publication in the Official Journal.

posts.title: Temporary derogation from certain provisions of the ePrivacy Directive to combat online child sexual abuse
posts.label: ✍️ Signed — publication next
posts.summary: The law temporarily allows exceptions to privacy rules for electronic communications to help authorities detect and stop child sexual abuse online. It permits enhanced monitoring and analysis of communications to identify material involving child exploitation.
posts.whatsNext: Publication in the Official Journal is next; the act enters into force on the date it specifies (default: the 20th day after publication).

posts.title: Temporary support and payment of advances regarding the increased fertiliser prices due to the Middle East crisis
posts.label: 📜 Published in the Official Journal
posts.summary: This law provides emergency financial support and advance payments to help farmers and businesses cope with rising fertiliser costs caused by the Middle East conflict.
posts.whatsNext: It's law. It enters into force on the date it specifies or, if none, the 20th day after publication in the Official Journal.

posts.title: Programme for agile and rapid defence innovation (AGILE)
posts.label: 🤝 Provisional deal between Parliament & Council confirmed
posts.summary: This proposal aims to create a programme that would help European defence companies develop and test new military technologies more quickly and efficiently. It seeks to speed up the process of turning innovative defence ideas into usable equipment.
posts.whatsNext: The deal is provisional: it still needs a plenary vote in Parliament and formal adoption by the Council. Although confirmation is expected, either institution can still decline.

posts.title: European Chemicals Agency and amending regulations
posts.label: 🤝 Provisional deal between Parliament & Council confirmed
posts.summary: This proposal would modify the rules governing the European Chemicals Agency and how it operates. It aims to update the regulations that establish and control this organization's responsibilities and procedures.
posts.whatsNext: The deal is provisional: it still needs a plenary vote in Parliament and formal adoption by the Council. Although confirmation is expected, either institution can still decline.

posts.title: Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL amending Regulations (EU) 2015/757 and (EU) 2023/1805 to simplify and streamline monitoring, reporting and verification and to align with revisions of the EU Emissions Trading System
posts.label: 📋 New legislative proposal
posts.summary: This proposal would simplify how shipping companies monitor and report their greenhouse gas emissions. It aims to align these reporting requirements with changes being made to the broader system for tracking and trading emissions across Europe.
posts.whatsNext: Parliament's lead committee and the Council's working party examine it in parallel. No deadline applies at this stage; most files take one to two-plus years.

posts.title: Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL amending Directive 2003/87/EC as regards revised benchmark values for the heat and fuel benchmarks for the period from 2026 to 2030
posts.label: 📋 New legislative proposal
posts.summary: This proposal aims to update the standard reference values used to measure heat and fuel efficiency under the EU's emissions trading system for the years 2026 to 2030. The revised benchmarks would establish new targets for how much heat and fuel different industries should use compared to the best performers in their sector.
posts.whatsNext: Parliament's lead committee and the Council's working party examine it in parallel. No deadline applies at this stage; most files take one to two-plus years.

posts.title: Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL amending Regulation (EU) 2019/943, as regards future-proofing electricity bills in the Union, through reducing system costs and fostering electrification and digitalisation
posts.label: 📋 New legislative proposal
posts.summary: This proposal seeks to modify rules on electricity pricing to make bills more affordable and sustainable by lowering overall system costs and encouraging more people and businesses to switch to electric power and digital technologies.
posts.whatsNext: Parliament's lead committee and the Council's working party examine it in parallel. No deadline applies at this stage; most files take one to two-plus years.

posts.title: Empowering Austria to amend its existing bilateral road transport agreement with Switzerland with a view to authorising cabotage operations in the course of the provision of international road passenger transport services by coach and bus in the border regions between the two countries
posts.label: 📜 Published in the Official Journal
posts.summary: Austria is given permission to update its road transport agreement with Switzerland to allow coach and bus operators to pick up and drop off passengers within each other's border regions while providing international services. This change facilitates easier cross-border passenger transport by coach and bus between the two countries.
posts.whatsNext: It's law. It enters into force on the date it specifies or, if none, the 20th day after publication in the Official Journal.

posts.title: Amending certain production, labelling and certification rules and certain rules on trade with third countries
posts.label: 🧭 Negotiating mandate for trilogue talks
posts.summary: This proposal aims to update the rules for how certain products are made, labeled, and certified, as well as how they can be bought and sold with countries outside the EU. The changes would modernize these existing regulations to reflect current needs.
posts.whatsNext: Trilogue talks with the Council can begin once the Council side has its own mandate. Closed-door rounds follow; timing is not published.

posts.title: Financial consequences of the expiry of the ECSC Treaty and Research Fund for Coal and Steel: implementation of Protocol No 37
posts.label: 📜 Published in the Official Journal
posts.summary: This legislation addresses the financial arrangements that result from the end of a treaty relating to coal and steel, and implements provisions for managing a research fund connected to these industries.
posts.whatsNext: It's law. It enters into force on the date it specifies or, if none, the 20th day after publication in the Official Journal.
